# BIO COMMUNITY
> Where Biology Comes to Life. Discover. Explore. Experiment.

BIO COMMUNITY is a school-based Biology learning community website.
The site publishes supplied experiment videos, associated short videos, microscope observations, and community activity documentation.

Main pages:
- index.html: Home
- about.html: About the community
- experiments.html: Experiment library
- experiment.html?id=experiment-01: Published experiment details
- shorts.html: Short-form videos grouped by experiment
- microscopy.html: Supplied microscope images
- activities.html: Supplied activity videos
- privacy.html: Privacy and media information

Only verified scientific details should be added to experiment and specimen records.
